description: NHFLOW 2D: a very light rigid body (empty 20 ft container, 59.3 kg/m3) falls 5 m onto 4 m deep still water, slams into it and comes to float.
covers: added-mass factor of very light rigid bodies in NHFLOW (5 times the estimate, at most 30 body masses: here 2.1)
probed pressure of rigid bodies without the low-pass filter of the non-hydrostatic part
rigid body falling through air into the water (dry and wet surface points), slam and rebound
